[F001] F001 is complete and verified. The guidance module (`command_guidance`) is referenced only by itself and its test file — it's not imported by any CLI router or command handler, confirming acceptance (5): no existing command behavior changes.

No side-effect (cloud/target-mutating) commands were run — only the local pytest suite and read-only Python introspection.

## Summary

F001's pure command-guidance contract was already laid down by the prep commit (`72559eb`) in `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/command_guidance.py`, and I verified it fully satisfies the acceptance criteria: a closed, frozen Pydantic `CommandGuidance` model carries `path`, `command_class`, `audience`, `examples`, `predecessor_hints`, and `human_escalation_rule`; the `CommandClass` enum is a closed vocabulary covering exactly the six required classes (read-only inspection, lifecycle mutation, dispatch/paid work, configuration mutation, diagnostic inspection, human handoff); and validation rejects unknown classes (via the str-Enum) and malformed examples (via field/model validators). The module is pure metadata — it imports `command_validation` for the command vocabulary but never the CLI router, and nothing in the codebase wires it into command execution, so no existing behavior changes. I strengthened the test coverage by adding four focused tests for the previously-untested `CommandExample` malformed-input validators (empty argv, empty/whitespace tokens, and empty description), making acceptance criterion
